name: La Fossa Seawall Transect
approach: Set tripod on the seawall ledge, level sensor at 30 cm above water.
exit_cue: First paddleboard group crosses the transect line.
sound: Low tide slap against concrete, gull harmonics.
access: Step-free ramp from Avenida Juan Carlos I; guardrail notch for equipment.

research.claim: Surface salinity 37.8 PSU with dissolved oxygen 7.1 mg/L at 06:45.
research.evidence: YSI ProDSS log + titration vial sample cross-checked with Copernicus CMEMS daily raster.
research.method: Collected vertical salinity/DO profile every 0.5 m, geotagged via Garmin 66i, compared to MaxEnt suitability surface adapted from Oysterbnb workflow.

composition.staging: Face east, align hydrophone with incoming tide lanes to keep water pulsing below 65 dB.
composition.approach: Walk the seawall when streetlights switch off to catch the blue gradient on Calpe Rock.
composition.exit: Pack when the paddleboarders disturb the surface sheen.
composition.sound_note: Concrete resonance adds a subtle 92 Hz hum.

name: Posidonia Benchmark Meadow
approach: Drop from the research ladder, follow guide rope 12 m to meadow marker.
exit_cue: Secchi disk visibility drops below 15 m or fishing charter enters zone.
sound: Snorkel bubbles, distant halyard bells, shrimp snaps.
access: Requires dive flag; ladder clearance 0.8 m at mid-tide.

research.claim: Posidonia shoot density 580 shoots/m² with epiphyte cover under 12%.
research.evidence: Quadrat photos + ImageJ counts; cross-validated with Generalitat Valenciana benthic survey 2018.
research.method: Replicated Oysterbnb MaxEnt workflow using salinity, turbidity, and slope rasters to model meadow extent; ground-truthed with underwater photogrammetry.

composition.staging: Hover 1.5 m above the canopy to watch sun pillars through the seagrass.
composition.approach: Descend slowly to avoid turbidity spike; match breath to gentle swell.
composition.exit: Clap twice on ladder rung to signal wrap.
composition.sound_note: Shrimp snaps punctuate a calm 58 dB(A) chorus.

name: Port Boardwalk Acoustic Line
approach: Set binaural rig midway between churro stall and fishing co-op gate.
exit_cue: When wind shifts above 12 kt from NE as logged at buoy 6123.
sound: Busker guitar layering with halyard rattles and low tourist groups.
access: Flat timber deck, tactile strips at stair edges.

research.claim: Evening composite comfort score 3.9/5 with average Leq 64 dB and wind chill 18°C.
research.evidence: Binaural Tascam DR-05X log + AEMET buoy 6123 wind dataset + Oysterbnb comfort rubric adaptation.
research.method: Applied Oysterbnb hex suitability scale to boardwalk microclimate: normalized sound, wind, and crowd counts in 5-minute bins.

composition.staging: Angle seating to face Ifach silhouette, sync tasting with passing fishing crews.
composition.approach: Arrive before golden hour to reserve bench and calibrate rig.
composition.exit: Leave when the NE gust crosses 12 kt or sound level climbs past 68 dB.
composition.sound_note: Layered strum at 120 bpm over halyard clinks.
